description: NaCa₃Fe₄(SiO₃)₈ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.91 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.84 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.82 Å. There are three inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.20 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.25 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.07 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-62°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.70 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.70 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Ca, two Fe, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCaFe₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Ca, two Fe, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Ca and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Ca, one Fe, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Fe, and one Si atom.
